purpose: Prevent the first pilot from overdetermining the cube while preserving the useful DOJ SLS discipline already earned.
statements: PILOT-001 remains useful and active, but it is not the project boundary.
No-person and no-incident are phase-bound safety states, not a permanent refusal to build entity and incident graphs.
Low-harm non-DOJ routes such as union-contract and policy-version inventories are attractive next branches because they pay down structural knowledge before person risk.
High-impact routes such as lawsuits, settlements, Brady/Giglio, decertification, and wandering detection remain central but must be fixture-first and gate-heavy.
